facts: Parties: Northgate Medical Ltd (Buyer), Whitlock Energy plc (Seller); the Company is Rothley Capital LLP.
This Agreement is dated 3 March 2027; Closing is scheduled for 28 April 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $6,500,000, capped at $10,000,000.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.
Present: 2 directors (of 5). The meeting was quorate. RESOLVED to approve entry into the Share Purchase Agreement.
Article 11: the quorum for board meetings is three directors.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Hartwell Robotics Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $7,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $4,800,000.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $63,180,000.
